Same as `0.1.9-r1`, with one correction.

### Upgrading from 0.1.7 or older
Stump 0.1.8 removed the `profile` setting (it used to pick the CORS debug mode; that is now decided
at compile time) and 0.1.9 rejects settings it does not know. **Delete the `profile = "…"` line from
your `Stump.toml` before upgrading** — the server rewrites the file on the next start, so it is a
one-time edit.

`0.1.9-r1` worked around this by ignoring unknown settings. That also hid typos in real settings, so
it is gone: the server refuses to start, as upstream intends, but the error now names the setting to
remove instead of only naming the file.
